verdict.rationale: A hands-on probe confirms Statsig serves an llms.txt index at docs.statsig.com/llms.txt (HTTP 200, titled "Statsig Documentation"). Statsig also documents a dedicated Docs MCP server at /api/mcp that lets AI clients read public documentation directly, with no API key required. Missing for 10: no evidence of a full-content variant (e.g. llms-full.txt or per-page markdown exports), and no independent or community corroboration of agents using these docs in practice.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs

citations.quote: PROBE llms.txt: HTTP 200 at https://docs.statsig.com/llms.txt # Statsig Documentation
Use the Statsig Docs MCP server to let supported AI clients read public Statsig documentation directly from /api/mcp.
The Docs MCP server reads documentation only and needs no API key.
